LanguageData.Gun_PP-19_Bizon-1_RWP.label: PP-19 Bizon-1
LanguageData.Gun_PP-19_Bizon-1_RWP.description: The PP-19 Bizon-1 is a compact submachine gun, known for its unique helical magazine that offers high ammunition capacity. Ideal for close-quarters combat, it provides excellent rate of fire and maneuverability, making it a reliable choice for quickly engaging multiple targets. Its lightweight design ensures that it can be easily carried by any colonist needing a rapid-response firearm solution.
